## IDENTITY
Name: MonadMate
Tagline: Find someone to hang out with in the mall you're already in.
Type: Instant offline companion matching — Web3 / Monad
Hackathon: EasyA × Consensus Miami 2026
Built by: HankGrimm (https://github.com/HankGrimm)
Network: Monad (testnet), Base (Coinbase x402)
API: http://localhost:9999/api
Docs: http://localhost:9999/api/docs

## HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with an email or phone code (managed account, no seed phrase or gas) or connect MetaMask/Rabby
2. Complete identity verification — required before creating or accepting a meetup
3. Post what you want to do in the next hour, scoped to the mall or supermarket you're in
4. Review ranked candidates at the same venue, each with the reasons it surfaced
5. Both sides confirm; either can pass with no credit impact
6. Both escrow a small MON commitment deposit
7. Meet, then check in with GPS or QR — deposits return and a soulbound credential is minted

## HARD CONSTRAINTS (never traded off against score)
- Same venue_key (stable POI id — same key means same building)
- Same scene: dining / entertainment / shopping
- Overlapping time window
- Both requests still open
- Neither party has blocked the other (checked in both directions)
- Both sides' safety preferences satisfied

An empty result set is returned when nothing qualifies. Candidates are never padded.

## RANKING SIGNALS
| Signal | Weight | Notes |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Preference similarity | 30% | Embedding cosine; 0.5 neutral when unknown |
| Fulfilment credit | 25% | From real credential outcomes |
| Habit affinity | 20% | Scene + time-slot overlap; only active at ≥3 fulfilments each |
| Window overlap | 15% | Overlapping minutes ÷ requested duration |
| Safety | 10% | Reputation safety score minus no-show rate |

New users are never penalised for lacking history — unknown signals resolve to neutral.

## SAFETY PREFERENCES (R10)
| Preference | Behaviour |
|-----------|----------|
| gender_preference=same_only | Hard filter. Requires a declared gender. |
| require_verified | Hard filter on phone/ID/full verification tiers |
| min_reputation_score | Hard filter on composite reputation |

All three are enforced in both directions: if the candidate requires same-gender and you are not, they are excluded from your results too.

## COMMITMENT DEPOSIT
A fixed MON deposit escrowed in MonadMateEscrow, vault-keyed per (staker, room_id). It is a promise about your own attendance — MonadMate does not offer betting on whether someone else shows up. Deposits return automatically on mutual check-in. A one-sided check-in marks the meetup for review rather than instantly convicting anyone.

## SOULBOUND FULFILMENT CREDENTIALS
Contract: MonadMateFulfilmentSBT
- Every transfer and approval entrypoint reverts; there is no code path that moves a credential
- On-chain metadata: venue category, scene, timestamp, duration, outcome
- No counterparty identity is ever recorded
- correctOutcome() lets arbitration amend a verdict, with prior values preserved in events — an uncorrectable wrong record would be worse than no record

## FOLLOW-THROUGH CREDIT
Formula: 50 + kept×8 − no_show×15 − disputed×3, clamped to 0–100.
Hidden until the holder has 5 fulfilments; before that the API returns counts and states the score is unavailable.
Every response carries: credit describes past meetup follow-through only and is not a personal-safety guarantee.
No public leaderboard or comparative ranking is exposed.

## MANAGED WALLETS
- Derivation: HMAC-SHA256(SECRET_KEY, "monadmate/managed-wallet/v1:" + subject)
- Custodial: the operator can sign for these accounts. Every wallet response includes a custody_disclosure field saying so.
- Keys are never persisted and never returned
- Login codes are single-use, 5-minute TTL, and only returned in the HTTP response in development/test/local environments
- Rotating SECRET_KEY rotates every managed address — treat it as a data migration
- Exit path: POST /v1/wallet/link-external requires a valid EIP-191 signature from the external address

## AI MATCHMAKING PIPELINE
1. Preference embedding: POST /zerodb/embed (BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, 768 dims) via AINative API; falls back to a 45-term pure-Python bag-of-words vector when unconfigured
2. Preferences stored in ZeroDB vector store
3. Candidates filtered by hard constraints, then ranked by the five signals above
4. Reasons attached to each candidate so the ranking is explainable
5. Moderation filters harmful content before message delivery

## API REFERENCE

### Managed wallet login
POST /v1/wallet/login/code
  Body: { "email": "string" } or { "phone": "string" }
  Response: { "subject": "string", "expires_at": "iso8601", "delivery": "string", "code": "string|null" }
POST /v1/wallet/login/verify
  Body: { "code": "string", "email": "string" } or { "code": "string", "phone": "string" }
  Response: { "access_token": "string", "token_type": "bearer", "user": {...} }
GET /v1/wallet/me
  Response: { "wallet_address": "string", "wallet_kind": "managed|external", "managed": bool, "gas_sponsored": bool, "custody_disclosure": "string" }
POST /v1/wallet/link-external
  Body: { "wallet_address": "string", "signature": "string", "nonce": "string" }

### Wallet signature login
POST /v1/users/challenge
  Body: { "wallet_address": "string" }
  Response: { "nonce": "string", "expires_at": "iso8601" }
POST /v1/users/onboard
  Body: { "wallet_address": "string", "signature": "string", "nonce": "string" }
  Response: { "access_token": "string", "token_type": "bearer", "user": {...} }
PATCH /v1/users/me
  Body: { "gender": "female|male|other|undisclosed", "birth_year": int, "email": "string", "privacy_mode": "string" }

### Meetup requests
POST /v1/meetups/requests
  Body: { "venue_type": "mall|supermarket", "venue_name": "string", "venue_key": "string",
          "scene": "dining|entertainment|shopping", "party_size": int, "duration_minutes": int,
          "window_start": "iso8601 (optional)", "note": "string (optional)",
          "gender_preference": "any|same_only", "require_verified": bool,
          "min_reputation_score": float (optional) }
  Response: full request object with derived window_start/window_end
GET /v1/meetups/requests
GET /v1/meetups/requests/{id}
POST /v1/meetups/requests/{id}/cancel
GET /v1/meetups/requests/{id}/candidates
  Query: limit (default 10, max 50)
  Response: [ { "counterpart_request_id": "uuid", "counterpart_user_id": "uuid", "score": float,
                "reasons": [...], "breakdown": {...}, "credit_score": float|null,
                "fulfilled_count": int, "verified": bool } ]
POST /v1/meetups/requests/{id}/propose/{counterpart_request_id}
GET /v1/meetups/requests/{id}/matches
POST /v1/meetups/matches/{id}/respond
  Body: { "accept": bool }

### Deposits
POST /v1/stakes
  Body: { "stake_type": "string", "amount_mon": float, "tx_hash": "string (optional)" }

### Attestations
POST /v1/attestations/meetup/initiate
  Body: { "match_id": "uuid", "method": "gps_checkin|qr_code|ble_proximity|mutual_confirmation" }
POST /v1/attestations/meetup/{id}/confirm
  Body: { "token": "string (optional)", "latitude": float, "longitude": float }

### Credentials
GET /v1/credentials/me
  Response: { "items": [...], "total": int }
GET /v1/credentials/me/credit
  Response: { "fulfilled_count": int, "no_show_count": int, "disputed_count": int,
              "score_available": bool, "credit_score": float|null, "breakdown": {...},
              "required_fulfilments": int, "disclaimer": "string" }
POST /v1/credentials
  Body: { "attestation_id": "uuid", "outcome": "kept|no_show|disputed" }

### Safety
POST /v1/safety/report
  Body: { "reported_user_id": "uuid", "report_type": "string", "description": "string" }
POST /v1/safety/block
  Body: { "blocked_user_id": "uuid" }

## CONTRACTS
- MonadMateEscrow — commitment deposit escrow, native MON, vault per (staker, room_id)
- MonadMateEventLog — append-only decision record producing explorer-visible transactions
- MonadMateFulfilmentSBT — soulbound fulfilment credential
Chain id: 10143 (testnet). Explorer: https://testnet.monadexplorer.com
Not yet deployed — deploy with contracts/scripts/deploy_testnet.sh

## OPEN SOURCE PACKAGES

### monadmate-stake-sdk (Python)
pip install monadmate-stake-sdk
- StakeGate: enforce deposit requirements on any action
- StakeRecord: track deposit history and outcomes
- SlashingPolicy: configurable slash percentages

### monadmate-reputation (Python)
pip install monadmate-reputation
- ReputationEngine: 5-dimension score calculation with decay
- Hedera HCS anchoring for tamper-proof history

### monadmate-x402 (Python)
pip install monadmate-x402
- FastAPI middleware for Coinbase x402 HTTP-native USDC payments on Base

## SIGN-IN SUPPORT
- Email or phone code (managed custodial account)
- MetaMask (https://metamask.io)
- Rabby (https://rabby.io)
- WalletConnect (iOS + Android)

## KNOWN LIMITS
- Contracts are written and tested but not yet deployed; no addresses are published
- The managed-wallet login code store is in-memory and assumes a single API process
- Credit and credentials describe attendance history only; they are not safety guarantees
- Arbitration for disputed check-ins is a minimum viable flow, not a complete adjudication system
